scenicChapters.title: Salta → Cuesta del Obispo
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 111 km. 3348 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Cuesta del Obispo → Cachi
scenicChapters.narrative: 3348 m come off over 64 km at around 7.8%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

valles-calchaquies.story: 390 km one way from Salta - plan on about 6 h 29 of riding. It goes by way of Cuesta del Obispo, Cachi and Molinos. The highest point is about 3,600 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

smugglers-notch-road.title: Smugglers' Notch Road
smugglers-notch-road.slogan: Vermont Route 108 through a cleft so narrow the boulders touch the tarmac.

waypoints.name: Jeffersonville
waypoints.advice: Jeffersonville is where the day begins. Next is Smugglers’ Notch, climbing 500 m.

waypoints.name: Smugglers’ Notch
waypoints.advice: You top out at 640 m here. The road climbs 500 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 3 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Stowe, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Stowe
waypoints.advice: The route ends here after 30 km. You lose 420 m on the way down to it, steadily.

sections.advice: Jeffersonville → Smugglers’ Notch, 14 km, climbing about 500 m. Part of Smugglers' Notch Road.
Smugglers’ Notch → Stowe, 17 km, dropping about 420 m. Part of Smugglers' Notch Road.

smugglers-notch-road.provenance: MANUAL SEED: every stop was entered by hand from a known position on the road. The distance is the seed figure, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces it. Altitudes are present only where they were known; the rest are null rather than zero.

scenicChapters.title: Green Mountain Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 14 km. 500 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Green Mountain Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: 16 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

smugglers-notch-road.story: 30 km from Johnson to Stowe, about 35 min of riding. The climb of the day is Smugglers’ Notch. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
